notes: The assimilated article of לַמִּלְחָמָה is unrepresented here because the ASV writes 'to battle' bare, in contrast with vv. 6 and 20 where a 'the' is written (rules 12, 29).
חָלוּץ is an anarthrous substantive taking the supplied 'man that is' with the construction's copula, headed on 'armed' (rules 46, 20).
